digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / CI provider matrix
propositions: External integration suite runs live tests against only one provider (Anthropic) rather than all credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetectable by CI automation.

Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows with explicit per-arm credential checks, so missing secrets produce loud skips rather than silent greens or indistinguishable from passing runs.

Provider override must use REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a config file setting only [llm.model_classes] to ensure config deep-merge semantics and dogfood the documented developer override path, not bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL.

Bedrock credential resolution on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials to a dedicated scoped role, not the S7 EC2 instance-role path which is unreachable from ubuntu-latest.

Bedrock region resolution fails silently with NoRegionError when both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION are not explicitly set, requiring both job-level env vars to prevent vacuous green runs.

Ambient default model resolution (cfg.model) was falling back to hardcoded claude-opus-4-8 (Anthropic) on all provider arms, causing three tests to call Anthropic even when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was deliberately blanked on non-Anthropic arms.
